name: Sonic Pro — Rapport hebdomadaire des demandes du site

parameters.query:
WITH boundary AS (SELECT date_trunc('week',now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto') AS local_end), period AS (SELECT (local_end-interval '7 days') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto' AS start_at,local_end AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto' AS end_at FROM boundary), requests AS (SELECT m.* FROM public.sonicpro_hostinger_messages m,period p WHERE m.workflow_id='3v0xFd3DTeK7T34W:hostinger' AND m.source_form_match AND m.state<>'system_test' AND m.created_at>=p.start_at AND m.created_at<p.end_at) SELECT (SELECT to_char(min(created_at) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto','YYYY-MM-DD') FROM public.sonicpro_hostinger_messages WHERE workflow_id='3v0xFd3DTeK7T34W:hostinger') AS tracking_since,to_char(p.start_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto','YYYY-MM-DD') AS period_start_date,to_char((p.end_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto')-interval '1 day','YYYY-MM-DD') AS period_last_date,p.start_at AS period_start,p.end_at AS period_end,'sonicpro:'||to_char(p.start_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto','YYYY-MM-DD') AS report_key,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests) AS total_requests,(SELECT count(DISTINCT lower(customer_email)) FROM requests WHERE customer_email IS NOT NULL AND customer_email<>'') AS distinct_submitted_emails,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE decision='process') AS approved_requests,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE reply_sent_at IS NOT NULL) AS acknowledged_requests,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE urgency='urgent') AS urgent_requests,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE urgency='uncertain') AS urgency_unknown,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE state='suspicious') AS rejected_requests,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE state='pending_review') AS pending_requests,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE state='delivery_failed') AS delivery_failures,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE state IN ('processing','sending')) AS in_progress,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_contacts c WHERE c.created_at>=p.start_at AND c.created_at<p.end_at) AS new_crm_contacts,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_contacts) AS total_crm_contacts,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_hostinger_messages WHERE workflow_id='3v0xFd3DTeK7T34W:hostinger' AND source_form_match AND state='pending_review') AS pending_backlog,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_hostinger_messages m WHERE m.workflow_id='3v0xFd3DTeK7T34W:hostinger' AND m.mailbox_processed_at>=p.start_at AND m.mailbox_processed_at<p.end_at) AS mailbox_handled,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_hostinger_messages m WHERE m.workflow_id='3v0xFd3DTeK7T34W:hostinger' AND m.state IN ('processed','suspicious') AND m.mailbox_processed_at IS NULL) AS mailbox_backlog,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_calendar_clicks c WHERE c.clicked_at>=p.start_at AND c.clicked_at<p.end_at) AS calendar_clicks,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT c.token) FROM public.sonicpro_calendar_clicks c WHERE c.clicked_at>=p.start_at AND c.clicked_at<p.end_at) AS clicked_requests,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_calendar_bookings b WHERE b.link_token IS NOT NULL AND b.status='confirmed' AND b.event_created_at>=p.start_at AND b.event_created_at<p.end_at) AS matched_bookings,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_calendar_bookings b WHERE b.link_token IS NOT NULL AND b.status='cancelled' AND b.event_updated_at>=p.start_at AND b.event_updated_at<p.end_at) AS cancelled_bookings,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_sns_notifications s WHERE s.created_at>=p.start_at AND s.created_at<p.end_at) AS sns_archived,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_sns_notifications s WHERE s.state='accepted' AND s.created_at>=p.start_at AND s.created_at<p.end_at) AS sns_accepted,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_sns_notifications s WHERE s.state='failed' AND s.created_at>=p.start_at AND s.created_at<p.end_at) AS sns_failed,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_sns_notifications s WHERE s.state='pending' AND s.created_at>=p.start_at AND s.created_at<p.end_at) AS sns_pending,
(SELECT last_success_at::text FROM public.sonicpro_integration_health WHERE integration='calendar_analytics') AS calendar_last_sync,
coalesce((SELECT last_success_at<now()-interval '15 minutes' FROM public.sonicpro_integration_health WHERE integration='calendar_analytics'),true) AS calendar_sync_stale FROM period p;

parameters.query: WITH claimed AS (INSERT INTO public.sonicpro_weekly_reports(report_key,period_start,period_end) VALUES($1,$2::timestamptz,$3::timestamptz) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING report_key) SELECT $4::jsonb AS report FROM claimed;
UPDATE public.sonicpro_weekly_reports SET state='sent',telegram_message_id=$2::bigint,sent_at=now() WHERE report_key=$1 AND state='sending' RETURNING report_key,state;
UPDATE public.sonicpro_weekly_reports SET state='failed' WHERE report_key=$1 AND state='sending' RETURNING report_key,state;

parameters.content:
# Rapport hebdomadaire
Lundi 09:00 America/Toronto, semaine complète précédente. Déclenchement manuel : aperçu sans publication.

Demandes, CRM, clics des liens d’accusé, réservations associées par correspondance du courriel après un clic dans les 30 jours, annulations, archive et acceptation SNS. Un clic ne prouve pas une réservation ; un MessageId SNS ne prouve pas la livraison. Les statuts sont ceux constatés au moment du rapport.

Agrégats seulement : aucune coordonnée client. Alerte de synchronisation si le dernier succès dépasse 15 minutes. Publication unique par semaine.
